boost_items.description: List of items that can be used to boost while riding this entity. Each item has the following properties:

duration.description: Time in seconds for the boost.

speed_multiplier.description: Factor by which the entity's normal speed increases. E.g. 2.0 means go twice as fast. Requires "format_version" of 1.20 or more, otherwise the value 1.35 will be used.

damage.description: This is the damage that the item will take each time it is used.

item.description: Name of the item that can be used to boost.

replace_item.description: The item used to boost will become this item once it is used up.

boost_item.description: List of items that can be used to boost while riding this entity. Each item has the following properties:

description: Defines the conditions and behavior of a rideable entity's boost.
